verdict.rationale: The Department of State publishes turnaround commitments only for its paid expedited tiers: 24 hours for $25, same day for $75 and 2 hours for $150. That is first-party processing-time information, but only for the expedite option. Nothing shows the service publishing current standard processing times or backlog for a given transaction type. Missing for 10: published current (live) processing times for standard non-expedited filings, per-transaction-type breakdowns (e.g., incorporation vs. name reservation vs. foreign authority), any update date showing the times are current.
